d.subject: Final handoff: public hinge-source liveness and equal-resolution selection
d.head: 98a7c1cde9fd36d47562b40fa25ed0b094038e70
confirmed: Preferred finer public candidate has no liveness demotion; live lower-resolution events can be rejected indefinitely after preferred source silence
Equal-resolution standard-over-vendor tie preference is computed but cannot cause a switch because switch predicate compares resolution only
d.corrected: Do not use blind wall-clock public-source expiry; ON_CHANGE candidates can be legitimately silent at stationary hinge. Use relative event-driven liveness and tune budget from Fold7 field traces.
fieldNeeded: per-candidate event skew/dropouts during slow open/close and reversals
d.en: Final R&D handoff: two public hinge selector defects are source+test confirmed at 98a7c1c. The selector can remain stuck on a silent finer source while dropping live fallback events, and equal-resolution standard preference is calculated but not enacted. An Android-free prototype compiles and passes 5/5 contract checks. Do not add a blind timer; use relative event-driven liveness and tune its budget from physical Fold7 traces. No production GitHub files were changed.
